needsBespoke.why: Nilah's core damage output against a single dummy depends on an unusual crit-chance-to-damage/armor-pen/heal conversion stack (Q passive: crit chance -> armor pen and -> heal%; Q active damage scaled by crit chance x crit damage multiplier; R heal% also scales with crit chance) that the closed primitive list captures piecemeal (crit-interaction, stat-conversion) but which needs bespoke formula wiring to combine correctly: Q's active damage term '(ActiveCritScaling=0.7)xcritChance)*(critDamage-1)' is a nonstandard crit-damage-partial-application formula not expressible as a simple crit-interaction primitive, and needs to be implemented as a literal bespoke calculation alongside the primitive tags.

proposal: Open by casting Slipstream (E) toward the dummy to close distance, resetting the basic attack timer and dealing E dash damage.
Immediately basic attack, then cast Formless Blade (Q) as soon as it hits (either on cooldown or during a subsequent Slipstream dash) to trigger the Q line damage and arm the empowerment buff.
While empowered, basic attack repeatedly to benefit from the empowered cone attack (100% AD bonus physical damage) and increased attack speed/range for the 4s window.
Recast Formless Blade every time its 4s cooldown is up, re-triggering empowerment continuously.

Recast Slipstream whenever a charge is available (roughly every 0.5-several seconds depending on the resolved cooldown/charge system) to reset the attack timer and add extra E damage, ideally paired with re-casting Q during the dash for the wave damage.

Cast Apotheosis (R) once available (~80-110s cooldown, so likely only usable at the very start if pre-fight or not at all within a single 15s window unless already up) for its channel DoT plus burst damage, accepting that it locks out basic attacks and other abilities during its ~1s channel.

Ignore Jubilant Veil (W) entirely in the damage fight since it provides no damage and is purely defensive/utility (movement speed, magic reduction, dodge) which the dummy fight does not need or benefit from offensively.
